session.expiringTitle: Your session is about to expire
session.expiringBody: If it expires you will be signed in again, which reloads this page and discards anything not yet submitted.
session.endedBody: Signing in again will reload this page, and anything typed here and not yet submitted will be lost. Copy any unsaved details before continuing.

auth.forbiddenTitle: This page is not available to your account
auth.noRoles: Your account has no roles assigned.
auth.askDistrictOfficer: If this is wrong, a district officer can correct your roles.

shell.notBuiltYetDescription: Routed and gated, but not built yet. The navigation shows it so the shape of the system is legible before every part of it exists.
shell.notFoundDescription: Check the address, or use the navigation.

transfer.title: Upload a transfer file
transfer.description: Births saved on a USB stick or card by a tablet with no signal. The file is sealed: only the registry can read it, so it names nobody while it travels.
transfer.notSealed: This is not a sealed transfer file from an NCBRS tablet. Choose the file the tablet saved.
transfer.unreadable: The file could not be read. Choose it again, or ask for a fresh copy from the tablet.
transfer.unreachable: The registry did not answer. Check the connection before trying again; the file is safe to upload again.
transfer.refusedTitle: The registry did not accept this file
transfer.duplicatesNote: Births already held were sent earlier, by this file or by the tablet itself. Nothing is registered twice.
transfer.rejectedNote: Tell the post: these births stay on the tablet, and the registrar corrects them there. The tablet learns of the refusal the next time it syncs.
